lede:
Solari's forty, briefed the way Korvan's were: each card anchored to the hardware of the part that grants it, and two cards off one part are two moments of the same machine. The world line changes for Solari: pale ceramic heat-shield tile and brass instead of Korvan's weathered steel, and the warm light is no longer rationed to one point — heat is the resource, so the machinery glows.

Approve, rewrite or drop each brief. Nothing is generated until you say so.

cards.actor: a short ceramic-tiled lance with brass bands
cards.on: a fat bolt of plasma leaving its tip
cards.moment: the lance tip still glowing orange from the shot, a single bright ember-coloured bolt just clear of it and crossing dark void.
cards.scale: a detail of a much larger machine: bolt heads, brass ring bands and ceramic tiles give the size.
cards.world: industry in space, not on Earth: the void is never flat black but a dithered indigo with a hot gold glare washing in from one edge; Solari machinery is pale cream ceramic heat-shield tile with brass rings and brass fittings, scorched amber at the seams; the machinery glows with its own heat -- orange coils, white-hot slots, ember-red metal -- against cold indigo shadow; tile and brass scuffed and patched and never marked with words; dark plating or deep indigo shadow packed solid behind the subject AND in every gap inside it, out to all four edges, never empty and never white
cards.avoid: No lettering, no stencilled words, no numbers. No figures. Never say gun, weapon, cannon, barrel, hull, vessel, shell, starship or flank.

cards.world: industry in space, not on Earth: the void is never flat black but a dithered indigo with a hot gold glare washing in from one edge; Solari machinery is pale cream ceramic heat-shield tile with brass rings and brass fittings, scorched amber at the seams; the machinery glows with its own heat -- orange coils, white-hot slots, ember-red metal -- against cold indigo shadow; tile and brass scuffed and patched and never marked with words; dark plating or deep indigo shadow packed solid behind the subject AND in every gap inside it, out to all four edges, never empty and never white
cards.avoid: No lettering, no stencilled words, no numbers. No figures. Never say gun, weapon, cannon, barrel, hull, vessel, shell, starship or flank.
